LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_CopyHelp: Make free copies of the selected documents at home. You can load them into a caravan for verification. Originals stay with you; copies retain their source, number and name redaction.
LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_PublicationHelp: Two independent recipients will receive copies of the selected documents. Your originals stay in the colony. Receipt is confirmed after the couriers arrive.
LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_HandoverHelp: The kingdom's envoy or courier will collect the selected documents from the colony. Unselected documents stay with you.
LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_Redacted: The clerk has not agreed to publish their name. Statement copies will have the name removed.
LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_NamedConsent: The clerk has agreed to be named in published materials. Copies already redacted will be sent as they are.
LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_ChooseHelp: Select each document individually. Only materials currently held at this home are listed.
LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_Empty: No kingdom documents are available at this home. Bring caravan-held documents home first.
LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_Stale: This commission has changed or paused. Close this window and reopen the current letter.
LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_Missing: Select at least one document still at home. If the materials have changed, close this window and select again.
LanguageData.RHAH_MaterialSelection_Failed: The documents have not been handed over. Check the materials and recipient, then try again.
